capabilities: Insert a live table of contents
extras: Free with an optional paid companion, Section Numbering Pro (one-time payment, 14-day trial), for multi-note numbering, cross-references, figure/table numbers, and HTML/Pandoc/LaTeX export. No network access or telemetry. Rewrites to links in other notes are written to disk and cannot be undone from the current note. Exposes a versioned API for other plugins to claim notes and react to renumbering.
intentEvidence: Notes numbered by the original Number Headings plugin are picked up and renumbered in place.
problem: Adding outline numbers to headings breaks any link that references a heading by its text, and renumbering after moving sections breaks those links again.

relations.evidence: Notes numbered by the original Number Headings plugin are picked up and renumbered in place.
Section Numbering Pro is an optional paid companion (one-time payment, 14-day free trial)

summary: Outline numbering plugin that numbers headings (1, 1.1, 1.2), renumbers them when sections move, and rewrites links to keep them working.
